verdict: The daily top 4, held with tp40-t40, is the walk-forward exit with the highest deduped mean (5.2%). On the holdout that mean is 1.3%, the median is -0.2%, the same-month same-volatility random mean is 216.6%, and the same predicted-volatility random mean is 2.4%. That holdout does not clear a random stock from the same month and volatility decile. From the entry, 31.4% of top-4 names reach a +30% high within 20 sessions and 26.6% reach a -30% low, against 18.8% and 14.9% for the volatility-matched names. Forward volatility is 123.9% against 119.8%. Once volatility is matched, the upside and downside tails are close. The model is largely selecting high-volatility names. 17.6% of the upside top 4 are also top-4 picks of the mirror model trained on a -30% low. Holdout top-4 lift is 4.69 with the option features and 4.79 with trailing return and volatility only. A 15% target with a 40-session cap has a median of +14.9% on the picks and the same median on the volatility-matched random book. The target, not the model, sets that median. The four-name holdout portfolio has CAGR 26.4%, max drawdown -11.8%, and Sharpe 1.04, against SPY at 12.4%, -9.2%, and 0.91.
